en.title: How Transformers Actually Predict the Next Word (Visual Guide)
en.subtitle: Skip dry equations: watch words turn into meaning coordinates, exchange context, and pick the next word.
en.whyWatch: 12.8m visual classic: the single clearest animation of how ChatGPT and Claude work under the hood.

steps.title: Turn every word piece into 'meaning coordinates'
steps.detail: Words with related meanings point in similar directions in space, letting the model do math on concepts.

steps.title: Pass context around + recall stored facts
steps.detail: Attention blocks let words talk to each other across the sentence, while feed-forward blocks pull in learned world facts.

steps.title: Score every possible next word (`temperature`)
steps.detail: The final layer scores the whole vocabulary; `temperature=0` always picks the safest top word while higher values add variety.

en.versionPatch: 2026 update: Today's frontier models still use this exact loop, adding lighter memory tricks (`RoPE` + `GQA`) so they can read whole books at once.
checklist: Follow one short 8-word sentence from raw text to the next-word prediction

en.title: How 'Attention' Connects Words Across a Sentence (Q, K, V Explained)

steps.title: `Query` asks a question; `Key` raises its hand
steps.detail: A noun like 'creature' sends a Query asking 'any adjectives describing me?', and 'fluffy blue' raises its Key to match.

steps.title: Hide future words during training so the model can't cheat
steps.detail: Masking out upcoming words lets the GPU practice predicting every word position in a page simultaneously.

steps.title: Run multiple 'attention heads' in parallel for different jobs
steps.detail: One head tracks grammar, another tracks who 'she' refers to, and another tracks code indentation.

en.title: Build a Working Mini-GPT from Scratch in ~80 Lines of PyTorch

steps.title: Write one clean `Head` of self-attention in 15 lines
steps.detail: Use a simple lower-triangular mask (`torch.tril`) so each position averages information only from earlier words.

steps.title: Add 'skip connections' so deep networks train smoothly
steps.detail: Passing a direct shortcut highway (`x = x + layer(x)`) keeps signals crisp across dozens of stacked layers.

steps.title: Stack multiple heads + a simple 2-layer MLP and watch it learn
steps.detail: Even on a laptop CPU/Mac, loss drops fast and the tiny model starts writing Shakespeare-style dialogue.

en.title: Reading 'Attention Is All You Need' Line by Line with Mu Li
en.subtitle: Why the 2017 Transformer beat older sequential RNNs on GPUs, and how modern GPTs simplified the original design.
en.whyWatch: 16.8m paper walkthrough: demystifies the exact architecture section of the paper that launched modern AI.

steps.title: Why RNNs bottlenecked and Attention unlocked GPU speed
steps.detail: Older models read one word at a time (`O(n)` steps); self-attention connects any two words in one step so thousands of GPUs train in parallel.

steps.title: Why the formula divides by `sqrt(d_k)`
steps.detail: As vectors get wider, dot-product scores grow huge and freeze learning — scaling keeps scores balanced.

steps.title: Why GPT kept only half of the original 2017 diagram
steps.detail: The original paper had both an Encoder and Decoder for translation; modern LLMs found that a unified Decoder-only stack scales best.

en.versionPatch: 2026 update: Skip memorizing the 2017 sine-wave position math — modern models use rotary positions (`RoPE`) on a clean Decoder-only stack.
checklist: Understand why parallel training made trillion-word pre-training possible

source.originalTitle: Let's build the GPT Tokenizer

en.title: Why AI Struggles to Count Letters in 'Strawberry': Tokenization Explained
en.subtitle: Andrej Karpathy reveals how text gets chopped into token IDs — explaining weird spelling bugs, indentation costs, and API pricing.
en.whyWatch: 17.2m eye-opening cut: nearly every 'dumb mistake' LLMs make on characters traces right back to the tokenizer.

steps.title: AI never sees individual letters — it sees merged `Token` chunks
steps.detail: Byte-Pair Encoding (`BPE`) glues frequent character pairs into single IDs, so `'strawberry'` arrives as 2–3 opaque number blocks.

steps.title: Trailing spaces and weird formatting confuse predictions
steps.detail: Leaving a stray space at the end of a prompt changes the final token ID completely and tanks completion quality.

steps.title: Bigger vocabularies save money on Chinese & code
steps.detail: Expanding vocab size to `150k–200k` packs multi-space code indents and CJK words into far fewer tokens.

en.versionPatch: 2026 update: Modern tokenizers cut Chinese/code token bloat sharply, and smart agents hand exact character counting or math off to Python tools.
checklist: Paste your own prompt into `Tiktokenizer` to see how many tokens your formatting eats
Never ask raw LLM text generation to count characters — run a 1-line script tool

zh.title: 为什么早期 AI 数不对单词里有几个字母 r？揭秘「分词器」背后的真相
zh.subtitle: 跟着 Karpathy 看清文字进大脑前的第一道工序：为什么多打一个空格会让回答变笨、Token 账单到底怎么算的。
zh.whyWatch: 17.2 分钟恍然大悟片段：很多让人抓狂的“AI 低级犯傻”，病根全出在切词这一步。

steps.title: AI 眼里根本没有单个字母，只有打包好的「词块编号」
steps.detail: 常见的字母组合会被合并成一个整体编号（比如整个词变成一个数字 `3921`），所以不借工具硬让它数里面有几个 `r`，就像蒙着眼拆盲盒。

steps.title: 提示词末尾不小心多留一个空格，切出来的编号就全变了
steps.detail: 切词规则对空格、换行和特殊符号非常敏感，干净利落的排版能让 AI 发挥稳定得多。

steps.title: 词表扩容后，写中文和写代码比早年省钱多了
steps.detail: 早期模型一个汉字要拆成两三个碎片算钱；现在主流模型把词表扩到十几个万，常用中文词和代码缩进都能一把打包。

zh.versionPatch: 2026 补充：虽然新模型词表更聪明了，但凡遇到「精确数字数、核对身份证位数、算账」这类活，正确做法永远是让 AI 调一行 Python 脚本去算。

steps.detail: 不用坐在屏幕前手动复制粘贴两百次，写几行简单循环脚本让它一次专注升好一个文件、自动检查过了再改下一个。

steps.title: 提交上线前，另开一个「毫不知情的新窗口」专门给刚才写的代码挑刺！
steps.detail: 刚写完代码的那个窗口会有“自己孩子怎么看都顺眼”的执念；新开一个零历史窗口直接把改动对比（`git diff`）丢给它审，挑漏洞又毒又准。

en.subtitle: 3Blue1Brown explains transformer clearly — watch the 0:47–6:12 core segment.
en.whyWatch: Skip the 7:58 full runtime — this 5.4m cut covers the exact Transformer mental model and pitfalls.

steps.title: Turn words into numbers with position tags
steps.detail: Before reading a sentence, the model turns each word piece into a list of numbers and marks its word order.

steps.title: Let every word look back at related words (`Attention`)
steps.detail: When reading 'it', attention lets the model look back to see which noun 'it' refers to, without peeking at future words.

steps.title: Combine context and predict the next word
steps.detail: Feed-forward layers pull in stored facts from training, while `KV Cache` saves past calculations so replies stream fast.

en.versionPatch: 2026 update: Today's leading models still run on this exact Transformer loop, adding smarter memory compression (`GQA` / `MLA`) to read much longer documents.

steps.detail: 模型不认识汉字或英文字母，第一步是把每个词变成一串代表意思的数字，并标上它在句子里的先后位置。

steps.detail: 一边靠注意力抓取上下文线索，一边调用训练时记住的常识，并把算过的结果缓存起来（`KV Cache`）加快吐字速度。

zh.versionPatch: 2026 补充：今天所有主流大模型底层仍是这套架构，只是给缓存做了大幅瘦身（如 `GQA`、`MLA`），让读长文更省显存更快。

steps.title: 建知识库前先选对向量模型与维度大小
steps.detail: 入库和提问必须用同一款向量模型；数据量大时优先选用支持缩减维度的模型，省下一大半内存开销。

steps.title: 第一步「指令微调（SFT）」：先拿标准问答范例教它怎么好好说话
steps.detail: 刚读完海量网页的底座模型只会顺着往下接话；喂几万条优质一问一答范例，它才学会像助手一样条理清晰地回复。

steps.title: Turn words into numbers with position tags
steps.detail: Before reading a sentence, the model turns each word piece into a list of numbers and marks its word order.

steps.title: Let every word look back at related words (`Attention`)

steps.detail: Feed-forward layers pull in stored facts from training, while `KV Cache` saves past calculations so replies stream fast.

steps.title: 先把文字变成带顺序编号的数字列表
steps.detail: 模型不认识汉字或英文字母，第一步是把每个词变成一串代表意思的数字，并标上它在句子里的先后位置。

steps.title: 用「注意力机制」回头找整句话里的关联词
steps.detail: 比如读到代词“它”时，自动回头看前文到底指哪样东西；同时遮住后面的字，保证练习时不偷看答案。

steps.title: 提取脑内知识算出下一个最可能出现的词

steps.title: Attach a 1-line document summary header to every chunk before indexing
steps.detail: Turning `'revenue grew 18% in Q3'` into `'[Acme 2025 Q3 Report] revenue grew 18% in Q3'` stops orphan chunks from getting lost.

steps.title: Load skills progressively (`short summary → SKILL.md → helper scripts`)
steps.detail: At startup the AI only sees a 1-line description per skill, reading the full manual only when a matching task arrives.

steps.title: 把工具设计成「5 到 8 个顺手的大动作」，别照搬几十个底层接口
steps.detail: 做好自动分页和字数裁剪，别查一次数据库就把几万行原始记录全倒进聊天框撑爆内存。

steps.title: 本地插件别乱往主通道打调试日志，团队共享服务做好读写权限分离
steps.detail: 本地 `stdio` 模式下乱打一行 `print` 就会把通信搞断；公司内部署则用 `Streamable HTTP` 区分只读查询和修改权限。

steps.title: 接入编辑器前先用官方 `MCP Inspector` 检查工具说明占多少字
steps.detail: 挂太多闲置插件会让 AI 变慢又费钱，平时只开当前项目真用得上的那几个。
